", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0032", "tag": "p", "text": "“And on your very wedding day,” she gasped reproachfully in the midmost of his embrace.", "sha256": "5baa4b97da99284933162686db029f198f1bfe6c532dbf8ee3ff17451c7c27cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1938]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“And this from you, Leoncia, at such a moment,” he murmured sadly.", "sha256": "bb7c65c155d873d50393642678a718aefa9b9f636e81181311c569e986c4254c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1940]", "source_html": "

“And why not?” she flared. “You loved me. You gave me to understand, beyond all chance of misunderstanding, that you loved me; yet here, to-day, you went out of your way, went eagerly and gladly, and married yourself to the first woman with a white skin who presented herself.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“You are jealous,” he charged, and knew a heart-throb of joy as she nodded. “And I grant you are jealous; but at the same time, exercising the woman’s prerogative of lying, you are lying now. What I did, was not done eagerly nor gladly. I did it for your sake and my sake——or for Henry’s sake, rather. Thank God, I have a man’s honor still left to me!”", "sha256": "24596c8ee30f10ea0b6ad0f1297360e8e722ca10675cffff25bc057168ac2a11", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1942]", "source_html": "

“You are jealous,” he charged, and knew a heart-throb of joy as she nodded. “And I grant you are jealous; but at the same time, exercising the woman’s prerogative of lying, you are lying now. What I did, was not done eagerly nor gladly. I did it for your sake and my sake——or for Henry’s sake, rather. Thank God, I have a man’s honor still left to me!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“Man’s honour does not always satisfy woman,” she replied.", "sha256": "fba7591a5c44a6d3085a8c1ec82ca727af2de52b25d784ecf7a9f8d3939c1cb8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1943]", "source_html": "

“Man’s honour does not always satisfy woman,” she replied.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“Would you prefer me dishonorable?” he was swift on the uptake.", "sha256": "74120a2e036d5f52fccadff2e3d383fe6f02ae0276e784d5bc233e58453bbcdc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1944]", "source_html": "

“Would you prefer me dishonorable?” he was swift on the uptake.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“I am only a woman who loves,” she pleaded.", "sha256": "6187d9484495c147bf93a48b0cf45d039f5cf3e76248f03f960eba7b15758060", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1945]", "source_html": "

“I am only a woman who loves,” she pleaded.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0040", "tag": "p", "text": "“You are a stinging, female wasp,” he raged, “and you are not fair.”", "sha256": "a2b7858ae6b026d22ea7812a54cb1ac19fe860f403c24ddc09c07a8793bad727", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1946]", "source_html": "

“You are a stinging, female wasp,” he raged, “and you are not fair.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u023-r0041", "tag": "p", "text": "“Is any woman fair when she loves?” she made the great confession and acknowledgment. “Men may succeed in living in their heads of honor; but know, and as a humble woman I humbly state my womanhood, that woman lives only in her heart of love.”", "sha256": "0da4fb29f6d920e62b75eb86423f0923551c8e5edc9776ee0bcf0986d660712a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1947]", "source_html": "
